RESIDENTIAL RENTAL AGREEMENT (fictional sample)
**Page 1**
1. Parties and Property. This agreement is made on 25 October 2026 between Ravi Menon ("Landlord") and Ananya Rao ("Tenant") for Flat 4B, Lakeview Residency, Dharwad.
2. Term. The tenancy lasts 11 months, from 1 November 2026 to 30 September 2027.
3. Rent and Late Fee. Monthly rent is ₹18,000, payable on or before the 5th of each month. A late fee of ₹200 per day applies from the 6th until payment.

**Page 2**
4. Security Deposit. The Tenant shall pay a deposit of ₹54,000 (three months' rent) before moving in. The deposit will be refunded within 60 days after the Tenant vacates, after deductions that the Landlord may make at his sole discretion.
5. Renewal and Rent Revision. The tenancy renews automatically for another 11 months unless the Tenant gives 30 days' written notice before the term ends. On renewal the Landlord may increase the rent by up to 15%.
6. Lock-in and Termination. There is a 6-month lock-in period. If the Tenant leaves during the lock-in period, the Tenant shall pay two months' rent as penalty. After lock-in, either party may terminate with 30 days' written notice.

**Page 3**
7. Repairs. The Tenant shall bear the cost of all repairs and maintenance, including structural repairs, regardless of cause.
8. Entry. The Landlord may enter the property at any time without prior notice.
9. Disputes. All disputes shall be settled by arbitration in Bengaluru before a sole arbitrator appointed by the Landlord.
10. Utilities. The Tenant shall pay electricity, water and internet charges directly.
